title: Assessing the Performance-Efficiency Trade-off of Foundation Models in Probabilistic Electricity Price Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2604.14739v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large-scale renewable deployment adds volatility to electricity prices. Probabilistic forecasts that quantify this uncertainty support trading, dispatch, and risk management, but it remains unclear which models produce the best forecasts for probabilistic electricity price forecasting (PEPF). Time series foundation models (TSFMs) promise strong performance without task-specific training, whereas task-specific deep learning models remain standard. We compare 4 models for day-ahead PEPF in European bidding zones: NHITS with quantile regression averaging (NHITS+QRA), a Transformer- conditioned normalizing flow, and 2 TSFMs, namely Moirai and ChronosX. Models are compared using proper scoring rules, namely the continuous ranked probability score and the energy score, together with calibration diagnostics. translated_title: 评估基础模型在概率性电价预测中的性能与效率权衡
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.14739v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：大规模可再生能源的部署增加了电价的波动性。能够量化这种不确定性的概率预测有助于电力交易、调度和风险管理，但目前尚不清楚哪些模型能为概率性电价预测（PEPF）提供最佳预测结果。时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）有望在不进行任务特定训练的情况下实现强大性能，而任务特定的深度学习模型仍是业界标准做法。我们在欧洲竞价区比较了4个日前概率电价预测模型：结合分位数回归平均的NHITS（NHITS+QRA）、基于Transformer条件化的归一化流模型，以及两个时间序列基础模型Moirai和ChronosX。模型比较采用适当的评分规则，即连续排序概率评分（CRPS）和能量评分，并辅以校准诊断。当仅在电价和日历特征上进行微调时，时间序列基础模型达到了最佳的预测精度和校准效果。然而，一个配置良好的（任务特定模型）……
tldr: 该研究在欧洲竞价区的日前概率电价预测任务中，比较了两个时间序列基础模型与两个任务特定深度学习模型，发现仅用电价和日历特征微调的基础模型可获得最佳的精度与校准效果，同时评估了模型性能与计算效率之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: This study compares two time series foundation models with two task-specific deep learning models for day-ahead probabilistic electricity price forecasting in European bidding zones, showing that foundation models fine-tuned only on prices and calendar features achieve the best accuracy and calibration, while assessing the performance-efficiency trade-off.
